parsed_json.up: Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND indication_label = 'breast cancer'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
